Silver Needle may practice the art of healing, yet they no longer uphold the ideal of "great medicine with utmost sincerity." After the Battle of Mount Mang, Sun Zhiwo, a divine healer, spread the knowledge of meridians across the land for the benefit of all. Countless healers followed in his footsteps, gathering in the Apricot Grove to establish the Silver Needle and pass down the art of medicine.
Healers practice their art with sincere hearts, yet has the world ever returned the sincerity? One pot of healing herbs cannot mend the hearts of a troubled era. Thus, the current Sect Master of Silver Needle sealed away the old plaque of "great medicine with utmost sincerity" and redefined the path of medicine. The Silver Needle heals by reading souls, and each life has its price. Their cure is not for a moment's relief, but for the Dao of the world.
